### To All the Saints at Philippi
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/to-all-the-saints-at-philippi
Passage: Philippians 1:1-2
Points:
- Paul likely penned this letter around AD 62 while under Roman imprisonment.
- Rather than responding to an urgent doctrinal crisis, Paul addressed personal updates, gratitude for financial support, and relational harmony.
- Even from prison, Paul greeted the saints with joy rooted in their shared fellowship in Christ.
- Christians are called to deepen their bonds with one another and embrace the epistle's call to rejoice in all circumstances.
